Probabilidad diaria de contestar una pro: Daily chance of answering a proposal (%)
Cambio máximo de postura entre coronas p: Maximum shift in stance between crowns per declaration
Los reyes pueden declararte la guerra si: Kings can declare war on you if you rule
Tu rey puede expulsarte o confiscarte un: Your king can expel you or confiscate a fief from you
Relación máxima con su rey para rebelars: Maximum relation with their king to rebel
Cansancio de guerra: recuperación al día: War weariness: recovery per day at peace (x10)
Cansancio de guerra: por día y guerra ab: War weariness: per day and open war (x10)
Cansancio de guerra: por ciudad o castil: War weariness: per lost town or castle
Segundos reales mínimos entre peticiones: Minimum real seconds between world requests
Proveedor para el mundo y la diplomacia: Provider for the world and diplomacy
Los proveedores se prueban en orden (1,: Providers are tried in order (1, 2, 3, 4): if the first one fails or runs out of quota, the next one is used. Keys are saved in Documents, in Mount and Blade II Bannerlord / Configs / ModSettings, not in the mod folder.
Escribe uno: gemini, openai, groq, deeps: Type one: gemini, openai, groq, deepseek, openrouter, ollama (local, no key) or other (then fill in the address).
Tu clave de ese servicio. Se ve en claro: Your key for that service. It is shown in plain text on this screen: don't show it in screenshots.
Nombre exacto del modelo. Vacío: gemini-: Exact name of the model. Empty: gemini-3.5-flash-lite, gpt-5.6-luna, llama-3.3-70b-versatile, deepseek-chat or llama3.1 depending on the service.
OpenAI-compatible base address, e.g. https://my-server/v1. For the known services it is filled in automatically.
Idioma de los menús, avisos y ventanas d: Language of AI Legacy's menus, notices and windows. "Auto" uses the game's language. To see this menu in the new language, leave the options and come back in.
Empty: the same language as the interface. If you want another one, type its name in English. E.g.: Spanish (Spain), English, Catalan, Italian.
Añade la charla libre a aldeanos, gente: Adds free chat to villagers, townspeople and tavern folk (not heroes).
A partir de este nivel de clan, cualquie: From this clan tier on, any NPC knows who you are without an introduction.
El NPC razona en privado (qué sabe, qué: The NPC reasons in private (what they know, what they want, whether an action makes sense) before speaking. Better replies, slightly slower.
Activado: hablas desde el cuadro de diál: On: you talk from the game's dialogue box (type → wait → see reply). Off: separate chat window.
Activado: al cargar una partida, los NPC: On: when you load a saved game, NPCs remember what they knew when you saved it. Off: they always remember the latest, even if you load an earlier saved game.
En la lista de personajes de una ciudad,: In the character list of a town, castle or tavern only "Visit" remains. You have to go to the person and talk to them in the scene.
SOLO PARA PROBAR. Los NPC aceptan casi c: FOR TESTING ONLY. NPCs accept almost any reasonable request (following you, tasks, gifts, troops) without you having to earn their trust first. Turn it off to play.
Activado: tu relación es con esa persona: On: your relation is with that person. Off (like the game): with a noble, your relation is that of the head of their clan.
Si se desactiva, los NPC solo hablan: no: If turned off, NPCs only talk: they don't give gold, don't join you, etc.
Un rey puede declararte la guerra o firm: A king can declare war on you or make peace with you if you are also a king.
Un líder de clan puede jurarte lealtad o: A clan leader can swear fealty to you or serve you as a mercenary if you are a king.
Los NPC que mandan un grupo pueden acept: NPCs who lead a party can agree to follow you, go somewhere, wait, patrol, attack, besiege, raid or join your army. Also by letter.
Cuánto te siguen, esperan o patrullan si: How long they follow you, wait or patrol if nothing else is agreed. Also how long they wait for you somewhere when you arrange to meet.
Mientras cumplen una orden no hacen su v: While carrying out an order they don't go about their normal life (they don't buy food or recruit), so it is best not to drag it out.
Distancia en el mapa a la que un NPC ve: Distance on the map at which an NPC sees enemies they can go and attack if you ask them to.
Cada NPC lleva la cuenta de cuánto se fí: Each NPC keeps track of how much they trust you. Without enough trust they don't share secrets or sensitive information.
Nivel de romance con cada NPC: sube con: Romance level with each NPC: it rises with courtship, cools if you don't see each other, and counts toward marriage.
The game only allows marriage between nobles. With this on, a companion, wanderer or notable you have won over can accept: they first join your household as a noble and stop taking up a companion slot.
Apagado: quien está casado (o tú, si lo: Off: someone who is married (or you, if you are) doesn't accept another wedding. On: they can accept it, and the previous marriage ends.
A partir de este nivel de romance contig: From this level of romance with you, the game does not marry that character off to someone else on its own.
Pasados estos días sin hablar ni escribi: After this many days without talking or writing to each other, romance drops 1 point per day (with your spouse it doesn't drop below 40).
Con romance alto, el NPC puede aceptar p: With high romance, the NPC may agree to spend the night with you (never described). Between spouses it can end in pregnancy.
Solo entre cónyuges (el juego necesita u: Only between spouses (the game needs a known father).
Un NPC con grupo puede cederte soldados: An NPC with a party can give you soldiers or prisoners, or accept the ones you offer.
Además, un NPC nunca cede más de un terc: Besides, an NPC never gives up more than a third of their party at once.
Peleas a puñetazos y duelos en las escen: Fistfights and duels in scenes, enemies attacking and surrendering on the map, and calling the guard.
Un vecino con el que has hablado de verd: A villager you have really talked to can give up their life and join your company: they become a permanent character, with their own name, personality and memory. Their appearance changes to that of the new character.
A veces la IA repite en su siguiente res: Sometimes the AI repeats a charge or payment that was already made in its next reply. The same amount, in the same direction and with the same person is not applied again within this time. 0 = no protection.
Tras una pelea o un duelo en un asentami: After a fight or duel in a settlement that is not yours, if a guard is nearby they come over to call you to account and decide: let you go, fine you or lock you up.
En una ciudad, aldea o castillo, si suel: In a town, village or castle, if you throw a punch at someone right in front of you, the fight with them starts without you having to talk to them: with fists if you are empty-handed, for real if you have your weapon drawn. Their relatives come to their defense and, if steel is drawn, so does the guard. They hold it against you, your bad reputation rises, and then the guard comes.
Si atacas a alguien con arma en una ciud: If you attack someone with a weapon in a town, nearby guards join in every few seconds. With several down, the alarm sounds and the whole guard comes.
Durante una pelea en la calle o en una a: During a fight in the street or in a village, Ctrl+X brings in ten of your soldiers and Ctrl+Alt+X as many as fit. They don't enter indoors. Those who fall are left wounded or dead in your party.
Mercaderes, artesanos, taberneros y alde: Merchants, craftsmen, innkeepers and villagers can sell to you and buy from you goods in a chat, against the real stock and prices of that place's market: goods and money really change hands.
Un personaje puede morir como desenlace: A character can die as the outcome of a chat: if they are your prisoner and you execute them by saying so clearly, if they take their own life, or if they are dying of their wounds. They really die in the saved game.
Apagado (recomendado): solo prisioneros: Off (recommended): only your prisoners and the wounded. On: the AI can decide the death of any character if the scene calls for it, including those of your clan.
Un vecino de una escena, o uno de tus so: A villager in a scene, or one of your soldiers, can agree to enter your service as a companion (if you have room) or remain as a named person you can find again. They keep their face, age and what you have talked about.
Si pegas o matas a alguien sin que nadie: If you hit or kill someone without anyone alive seeing it, nobody knows it was you: no bad reputation, no guard, no name in the news. If they see you but don't know who you are, they look for "an armed stranger" and the bad reputation is halved. They only name you if a witness knows you or if you are already famous.
En una conversación de grupo en ciudad o: In a group conversation in a town or castle, a guard or whoever is in charge there can take another character present into custody if there is a serious reason (e.g. you accuse them of a crime with evidence in plain sight). They are really imprisoned, and they hold it against you.
Si la guardia te encierra fuera de tu fe: If the guard locks you up outside your fief and your kingdom, the lord of the place passes sentence (release, fine or days in the dungeon), changes your reputation there and what they think of you, and their sentence is announced as news. They need to know who you are there.
En peleas y duelos dentro de una escena,: In fights and duels within a scene, your opponent says lines depending on how it's going, and onlookers shout. Just one request to the AI when the fight starts.
El guardia puede pasarse hasta cinco vec: The guard can go up to five times over this value if there was blood or you disrespect them.
Si ganas un duelo a muerte contra un hér: If you win a duel to the death against a hero, they die. You never die: you are left badly wounded.
La tensión sube con insultos y amenazas: Tension rises with insults and threats and drops with the days. With high tension the NPC can turn to violence or call the guard. They also gauge whether you frighten them (your troops against theirs).
A partir de aquí puede atacarte por su c: From here on they can attack you on their own or call the guard. Agreed duels and fights don't need it.
Los NPC pueden encargarte cosas, anotar: NPCs can give you tasks, note your progress, and mark them fulfilled (with reward) or failed. They appear in the game's quest log. Careful: a saved game with tasks needs AI Legacy to load.
Si fracasa o se pasa el plazo pierdes la: If you fail or the deadline passes, you lose half.
Dar y recibir objetos, documentos de rol: Giving and receiving items, roleplay documents (letters of introduction, contracts, safe-conducts) and buying workshops by talking.
Cada personaje con nombre guarda cómo se: Each named character keeps track of how they get along with other characters and the latest thing that happened between them (their chats, an errand, a snub in front of you, an arrest). They use it when they talk to each other, in groups and with you. It is stored in their file, under "others".
Cuando una charla deja a dos personajes: When a chat leaves two characters clearly better or worse off, their in-game relation goes up or down by one point.
Las fichas antiguas o importadas de AIIn: Old character sheets, or ones imported from AIInfluence, only come with personality, past and way of speaking. With this on, in the next chat with that character the AI writes what is missing (what they seek, their secret, what drives them, values, religion, reputation, example phrases) without touching what was already there.
Las frases que salen del historial al re: Sentences that leave the history when summarizing are archived. When you talk, the ones related to what you are saying now (names, places, specific things) are looked up and the character remembers them word for word. It doesn't use extra requests.
Cuántas frases viejas se guardan de cada: How many old sentences are kept for each character so they can be recalled. More = better long-term memory and somewhat larger files.
Cada vez que se resume un tramo de vuest: Each time a stretch of your shared story is summarized, the AI writes a titled page: it can be read in the Book of memories.
Cada personaje nace de un molde (world_d: Each character is born from a mold (world_data\archetypes.json) that sets their morals, how they speak and how much they believe. Editable.
world_data\\religion.json y cultural_tra: world_data\religion.json and cultural_traditions.json: the faith and customs (courtship, hospitality, oaths) of their people. Editable.
Tras un suceso que le marca (una traició: After an event that marks them (a betrayal, a death, a vow, falling in love), the AI slightly adjusts their personality and notes it in their past.
Guerras, paces, batallas, asedios, muert: Wars, peace treaties, battles, sieges, deaths... NPCs find out depending on importance and proximity.
Lo que pasa en una charla puede correr d: What happens in a chat can spread by word of mouth.
Personajes con los que tienes historia t: Characters you have history with write to you on their own.
Denarios por unidad de distancia en el m: Denars per distance unit on the map. Letters are sent from the tavern district.
10 = 1 hora por unidad de distancia. Más: 10 = 1 hour per distance unit. Farther = takes longer to arrive (and for the reply to come back).
Prueba cada proveedor (los de «0. Claves: Tests each provider (those in "0. AI Keys" and, if present, those in config.json) and shows the result in the game's log.
Nombre de un proveedor: el servicio que: Name of a provider: the service you typed in "0. AI Keys" (gemini, openai; the one in slot 2, 3 or 4 carries its number: openai2) or one from config.json. Empty = the normal chain. If it fails, the rest are used.
Con un señor enemigo también puedes desm: With an enemy lord you can also dismount and talk face to face. When you return to the map, the encounter continues where it was (attack, surrender, let you go), unless it was resolved in the chat.
Al encontrarte en el mapa con un señor c: When you meet a lord on the map you are not at war with, the option "Let's dismount and talk face to face" appears: a scene of the terrain opens with the two of you on foot and your people behind you. Tab to return to the map.
Cuántos de cada partida aparecen detrás: How many from each party appear behind their leader (first their heroes, then their best troops).
El jefe de cada bando que no mandas tú r: The leader of each side you don't command periodically receives the state of the battle and gives real orders to their formations, according to their personality and skill. While they decide, or if the AI fails, the game's own tactics continue. It doesn't act in sieges.
Cada decisión es una petición a la IA po: Each decision is one request to the AI per side. If a side suddenly loses many people, it decides sooner.
El ejército aliado con jefe propio, y tu: The allied army with its own leader, and your side when you are not the one in command (the formations you lead are not touched).
En batalla, Alt+B: escribes la orden com: In battle, Alt+B: you write the order as you would say it ("cavalry on the left against their archers") and the AI turns it into orders for your formations. The game pauses while you type.
Lo que cada jefe brama a los suyos sale: What each leader bellows at their men appears in the log (and above their head if they are near).
Muestra en el registro qué ha ordenado c: Shows in the log what each leader has ordered each formation.
Nombre del proveedor de config.json que: Name of the config.json provider preferred for battle orders (empty = the normal one). A fast one is best.
En las escenas, lo que dicen los persona: In scenes, what characters say to each other or shout at you in passing appears written above their heads.
De vez en cuando, dos personajes que est: From time to time, two characters near you talk about what is going on: news, shortages, disease, their lord. Uses one short request to the AI each time.
Además de sobre su cabeza, las frases qu: Besides above their heads, the sentences characters exchange appear in the message log (bottom left).
Si los dos que van a charlar no están ju: If the two who are going to chat are not together, one walks over to the other before starting (also between floors, if there is a path).
En un salón los nobles están separados:: In a hall the nobles are spread apart: with a low value they never find anyone to talk to.
La IA escribe entre la mitad y este núme: The AI writes between half of this number and this number, depending on what the topic allows. It is a single request, long or short.
Apagado: solo charlan entre sí quienes t: Off: only named characters (lords, ladies, notables, wanderers) chat among themselves. On: villagers, innkeepers and others too, but just two or three short sentences.
Por defecto no: están de servicio. Sigue: Off by default: they are on duty. They still answer if you talk to them.
Cuando caminas junto a alguien en una es: When you walk next to someone in a scene (guards, villagers, merchants, nobles who don't know you), they say something in passing. Uses ONE request per visit to each place: a batch of sentences is requested and used up gradually. Turn it off if you don't want that cost.
Cada lote extra es una petición más en e: Each extra batch is one more request on that visit. 0 = only the first.
Apagado: cada charla entre personajes se: Off: each chat between characters is written whole in one request. On: it is requested in turns and each round knows what was said before; they can interrupt each other and the chat ends on its own if you step in. Uses several requests per chat.
1 = una petición por frase (lo más caro): 1 = one request per sentence (the most expensive). 2 = half the requests.
Si no dices nada durante este tiempo, la: If you say nothing during this time, the AI decides whether someone in the group continues the conversation (pushes you, or they start talking among themselves). Each time is one request.
Cuántas veces seguidas pueden continuar: How many times in a row they can continue the conversation without you saying anything. When you speak, the count starts over.
Al abrir una conversación de grupo, los: When opening a group conversation, the participants walk until they form a semicircle in front of you and look at you. Anyone seated or busy stays where they are.
Encendido: al abrir la ventana de Alt+T: On: when you open the Alt+T window the scene goes on, in slow motion. Off: the game pauses while you type.
Quien está cerca y oye lo que dices al g: Anyone nearby who hears what you say to the group can walk over and join the conversation if they have a stake in it. Doesn't use extra requests.
Distancia a la que alguien de fuera oye: Distance at which someone outside hears the conversation. A shout (!) reaches twice as far; a whisper (*), only whoever you are looking at.
En las charlas de escena, quien habla po: In scene chats, whoever speaks makes the face and gesture of what they feel (nodding, denying, doubting, getting angry…). Anyone seated, busy or walking only changes their face.
Si lo que dices en una conversación de g: If what you say in a group conversation gives them reason to, the character can act: go talk to someone else and come back to tell you, accompany you, stay, guide you to someone, call someone over, or leave.
Tiempo sin charlas nuevas después de que: Time without new chats after one ends. The same two take twice as long to talk again.
En una escena, Alt+T: hablas a todos los: In a scene, Alt+T: you talk to everyone near you and the AI decides who answers. Their replies appear above their heads and in the log. Press Alt+T again to keep talking.
Los personajes con nombre que están a po: Named characters who are a few steps away when you talk to someone in a scene overhear what you say, and remember it.
Brotes de temporada o por un evento: dañ: Outbreaks by season or from an event: they damage the settlement, spread to neighbors, sicken your troops if you enter, and are slowed by quarantines.
Al entrar o quedarte en un sitio con enf: When entering or staying in a place with disease, some of your soldiers may fall ill (they are left as wounded).
Lo que dices o haces delante de un NPC p: What you say or do in front of an NPC can reach their lord, their family or their friends, delayed according to distance. What arrives is their version, not a fact.
Un noble que ya te conoce y pasa cerca p: A noble who already knows you and passes nearby may ride up to you to talk, if they have a reason: an open task, something they heard about you, affection or resentment. They ask whether you will receive them.
Cada cierto tiempo la IA escribe sucesos: From time to time the AI writes new events based on the real state of the world (politics, war, economy, society, mysteries). They appear in News and NPCs know about them.
Cuando ocurre algo sonado en el juego (u: When something big happens in the game (a war, a peace, a captured town, the death or capture of someone important, a big rumor from your chats), the AI immediately writes how the world takes it.
En el menú de cada ciudad, «Visitar el h: In each town's menu, "Visit the hospital": they tell you about the diseases going around, treat you, your companions, your wounded or sick troops and your prisoners (for a fee; cheaper in prosperous towns), and sell prevention so your men fall ill less for a few days.
Un suceso puede encarecer o abaratar tod: An event can raise or lower the prices of an entire town or village market while it lasts (shortage, panic, abundance). 0 = events don't touch prices.
Cada cierto tiempo llega a una ciudad ce: From time to time someone new, invented by the AI for this saved game, arrives in a nearby town (a fugitive physician, a mercenary captain, a preacher…), with name, trade, personality and motive. They live like a wanderer: you can look for them and take them into your service. One request per character.
Cuando muere un personaje con el que has: When a character you have talked to several times dies, the AI writes their chronicle (who they were, what there was between you, how it ended). It appears on screen and stays in News. One request per chronicle.
En la arena de cada ciudad, «Entrenar a: In each town's arena, "Train your troops": you pay, 8 hours pass and your healthy soldiers gain experience (more for novices). Some may get injured. Each arena takes a few days to admit you again.
La IA inventa los secretos a partir de l: The AI invents the secrets from the real people of each kingdom (their houses, weddings, debts, grudges) and from the events as they happen. Each one concerns specific people and is known by a few, who only let it out with trust. Uses one request per kingdom, spread one per game day at the start of the saved game.
Apagado por defecto. Encendido: también: Off by default. On: the generic secrets written in that file are also handed out at random (you can put your own there).
Un suceso puede manchar o ensalzar el no: An event can stain or exalt the name of a specific clan (yours too): its income drops or rises by a percentage for a few days. It shows in the clan's income breakdown and in News.
Una agresión tuya en la calle, un muerto: An aggression by you in the street, a death, an arrest, or a weighty rumor you set rolling in a chat, becomes a world event with its news (and with effects on the place if there was blood). It only tells what the witnesses could have known. It is one request to the AI per event.
1 = cualquier suceso local, 2 = asuntos: 1 = any local event, 2 = court matters, 3 = what shakes a kingdom, 4 = only what shakes the world.
Si pasan varias cosas seguidas, se junta: If several things happen in a row, they are combined into a single reaction.
Además de las reacciones, cada cierto ti: Besides reactions, from time to time the AI writes what is brewing on its own: intrigues, shortages, omens, unrest.
No cae como un reloj: el plazo real varí: It doesn't fall like clockwork: the actual interval varies between 60 % and 140 % of this value.
1 = todos, 4 = solo los que sacuden el m: 1 = all, 4 = only those that shake the world, 5 = never.
Un evento puede cambiar cada día, durant: An event can change, each day for a while, the prosperity, food, security and loyalty of a real settlement.
Los clanes del juego dejan de proponer g: The game's clans stop proposing wars, peace, alliances and trade on their own. Kings decide them through public declarations. Requires world events to be enabled.
Un rey puede crear una ley propia con ef: A king can create a law of their own with small daily effects in all their towns and castles (loyalty, prosperity, security, food), and repeal it.
Un evento puede hacer que un clan vasall: An event can make a vassal clan rise against its crown (never yours nor the ruling clan), if it truly gets along badly with its king.
A captured noble counts as a third.
Para no gastar cupo cuando avanzas el ti: So as not to spend quota when you advance time quickly.
Nombre de un proveedor de config.json. V: Name of a config.json provider. Empty = the normal chain.
Con una partida cargada: pide ya una tan: With a saved game loaded: requests a batch of events right now (they appear when you return to the map).
Abre en tu navegador el editor: mundo, s: Opens the editor in your browser: world, secrets, NPCs (personality, memory, instructions), events and backups. Requires a saved game to be loaded.
Con una partida cargada: trae de AIInflu: With a saved game loaded: brings in from AIInfluence the memory, personality, memories and instructions of the NPCs of THIS campaign. It doesn't overwrite anyone who already has memory in AI Legacy.
Quita de esta campaña las memorias que v: Removes from this campaign the memories that came from AIInfluence (for example, if you imported those of another saved game). The files are moved to a subfolder, not deleted.
Va al principio de cada conversación. Es: It goes at the start of every conversation. Write it in English (replies come out in your language). It applies from the next sentence.
Lista JSON: id, text, chance (0-100), wh: JSON list: id, text, chance (0-100), who (all, lords, faction_leaders, clan_leaders, companions, wanderers, merchants, gang_leaders, town_notables, village_notables, townsfolk, villagers, guards, culture:id, kingdom:id or hero id).
Igual que los hechos, más \"access\": lo: Same as the facts, plus "access": low / medium / high (how much trust is needed to tell it).
Los inventa la IA a partir de la gente r: The AI invents them from the real people of each kingdom and from events. They appear gradually (one kingdom per game day). Here you can see who each one is about and who knows it; you can delete the ones you don't like.
Un personaje nuevo que entra en tu clan: A new character who joins your clan and your party (if you have a companion slot). You can then generate their personality with AI from their sheet.
Un pariente tuyo con el parentesco de ve: A relative of yours with real kinship in the game. For a sibling you must first have a father or mother.
Instrucciones tuyas (una por línea; mand: Your instructions (one per line; they override everything else)
Qué le mueve y qué teme: What drives them and what they fear
Qué respeta y qué desprecia: What they respect and what they despise
Cómo trata a superiores, iguales, inferi: How they treat superiors, equals, inferiors and strangers
Humor, cuánto miente, cómo decide, cuánt: Humor, how much they lie, how they decide, how much they trust
Escribe toda la ficha de arriba a partir: Writes the whole sheet above from who they are in the saved game (family, clan, traits, personality mold), without you having to talk to the character in the game. Overwrites what is there. It is one request to the AI.
Optional: something you want them to have (e.g. "is a coward but hides it with bravado")
Resumen de lo vivido contigo: Summary of what you have been through together
Te conoce como (vacío = no sabe tu nombr: Knows you as (empty = doesn't know your name)
Se publica al momento como noticia: los: It is published immediately as news: NPCs find out depending on importance (1 = the place, 2 = the court, 3 = the whole kingdom, 4 = the whole world). Those involved and their clan always know.
Descripción (lo que leerán los NPC; mejo: Description (what NPCs will read; better in English, but any language works)
Cartas, sellos, contratos, prendas… No s: Letters, seals, contracts, garments… They are not game items: they exist for the story. Characters know you carry them if you show or hand them over in a chat.
Qué es y qué dice: What it is and what it says
Una carta con el sello imperial en la qu: A letter with the imperial seal in which…
Se abren en el Explorador de Windows del: They open in the Windows Explorer of the computer where the game runs.
Toda la memoria de AI Legacy de esta par: All of AI Legacy's memory for this saved game (NPCs, news, letters). It is also stored inside the saved game when you save in the game.
Datos del mundo (JSON). Valen para todas: World data (JSON). It applies to all saved games. When saving, a .bak copy of the previous one is kept.
Plantilla de lo que se le dice a la IA,: Template of what is said to the AI, for this saved game only. What goes between {llaves} is filled in by the mod: do not delete or translate it. It applies immediately.
¿Volver al texto de fábrica? Se pierde l: Restore the factory text? What you have changed will be lost.
Carpeta abierta en el equipo del juego: Folder opened on the game computer
ya es de tu familia: is already part of your family
¿Generar la personalidad con IA? Pisa la: Generate the personality with AI? It overwrites the current sheet.
· ya no está en la partida: · no longer in the saved game
Guardado. Recuerda guardar la partida en: Saved. Remember to save the game in the game.
Esto SUSTITUYE toda la memoria actual de: This REPLACES all of AI Legacy's current memory. Are you sure?
No se pudo conectar con el juego:: Could not connect to the game:
Todavía no hay ninguno: se van escribien: There are none yet: they are written as game days pass.
